verdict.rationale: Apple's docs say the M4 Max Media Engine has two video encode engines and two ProRes encode/decode accelerators, and that it handles multiple 4K ProRes streams. That covers the ProRes-class part of the story on the chip itself. However, no specific codec beyond ProRes is named, so AV1 and HEVC support is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented AV1 hardware decode, documented HEVC/H.264 hardware encode and decode, streaming-specific encode evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of media engine performance.
